fix(tool-web-fetch): return network_error for invalid redirect Location (#24297)

## Background

- `tool-web-fetch` follows redirects by resolving each `Location` header
with `new URL(location, currentUrl)`
- that call sat outside a `try`/`catch` block, so errors (e.g. a
malformed `Location` header) made the tool throw instead of returning a
structured error
- every other error in the loop returns structured errors that models
can recover from, so this is inconsistent

## Summary

wrap in a try/catch block and return a structured error from the tool
